additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390654-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R6 170002154] Outlet 1: error, LEMState: Working CRM:00921001296
additional_info.body:
Good morning Emre,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0390654
, opened for outlet DC1 OoO on charger
s9d9zk
.
After connecting remotely to the charger, I believe that the EcoG-LE is faulty on this charger, leading to Outlet 1 going out of order.  I connected via ssh to the EcoG-LE, and I noticed that the Pilot state is in “Invalid” status, and that there is the error “could not configure local station for slac”, as per picture below:
This error is not reflected in SCB logs, and it is a known EcoG failure due to internal communication problem. The only solution, at the moment, is to replace the EcoG-LE controller.
Please be aware that we are working along with EcoG team to resolve the issue, hence I am requesting you to send the faulty unit back to the factory for analysis.
Therefore, please replace the EcoG-LE as soon as possible, so to make outlet DC1 available again, and please share the faulty EcoG serial number to me once onsite.
I will move this ticket to the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue (Level2),
so for you to proceed with the onsite replacement.
Please let me know if you need further support from my side. Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
eMobility Service Delivery
Expert Services
SI E CS SD ES
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
